source: e2e dev-diagrams + mermaid-example blocks in docs/syntax/{bpmn,bpmnElements}.md

entries.name: dev/01-order-handling.mmd
entries.source:
bpmn-beta LR
title Order handling
  pool "Order handling"
    lane "Sales"
      start message s1 "Order received"
      user task t1 "Approve order"
        boundary timer b1 "2 days"
      xor gw "Approved?"
    lane "Warehouse"
      service task t2 "Pick items"
      end e1 "Shipped"
  s1 --> t1 --> gw
  gw -- yes --> t2 --> e1
  b1 --> t2

entries.name: dev/02-collaboration.mmd
entries.source:
bpmn-beta LR
  pool "Customer"
    lane "Buyer"
      start c1 "Places order"
      end c2 "Receives goods"
  pool "Supplier"
    lane "Sales"
      receive task t1 "Receive order"
      send task t2 "Confirm order"
      end e1 "Order handled"
  c1 -.-> t1
  t1 --> t2 --> e1
  t2 -.-> c2

  lane "Throwing events"

entries.name: dev/05-gateways-and-activities.mmd
entries.source:
bpmn-beta TB
  lane "Gateways"
    xor g1 "Exclusive"
    and g2 "Parallel"
    or g3 "Inclusive"
    event-gateway g4 "Event-based"
    complex g5 "Complex"
  lane "Activities"
    user task t1 "User"

    script task t3 "Script"

entries.name: dev/08-black-box-pool.mmd
entries.source:
bpmn-beta LR
  pool "Order handling"
    lane "Sales"
      start message s1 "Order received"
      user task t1 "Approve order"
      service task t2 "Charge the customer card"
    lane "Warehouse"
      service task t3 "Pick items from the shelves"
      end message e1 "Customer has been notified of shipment"
  pool "Courier"
  pool "Supplier"
  s1 --> t1
  t1 --> t2
  t2 --> t3
  t3 --> e1
  t1 --> e1

nodes.label: Customer has been notified of shipment

entries.name: dev/09-data-associations.mmd
entries.source:
bpmn-beta LR
  pool "Order handling"
    lane "Sales"
      start s1 "Order received"
      data-input d1 "Order form"
      user task t1 "Check the order"
      data-output d2 "Approval"
      data-collection d3 "Line items"
      end e1 "Filed"
      note n1 "Against the price list"
  s1 --> t1
  t1 --> e1
  d1 ..> t1
  t1 ..> d2
  d3 ..> t1
  n1 ... t1

entries.name: dev/10-cross-pool-message-flows.mmd
entries.source:
bpmn-beta LR
title Message flows between four participants
  pool "Laboratorium"
    lane "Systemy"
      end message a1 "Raport przekazany"
  pool "Scudo AI Desktop"
    lane "Operator"
      start message b1 "Operator wskazuje pliki"
      end b2 "Gotowe"
  pool "SharePoint"
    lane "Graph"
      task c1 "Zapis pliku w kanale"
  pool "Gabinet"
    lane "Lekarz"
      end d1 "Lekarz odczytuje raport"
  a1 -.-> b1
  b1 --> b2
  b2 -.-> c1
  c1 -.-> d1

entries.name: dev/11-gateway-branches.mmd
entries.source:
bpmn-beta LR
title A gateway branching above and below its own line
  pool "Handling"
    lane "Work"
      start message s "Request received"
      xor gw "Which way?"
      user task up "Check the register"
      service task down "Charge the card"
      end e "Filed"
  s --> gw
  gw -- nie --> up
  gw -- tak --> down
  up --> e
  down --> e

parsed.title: A gateway branching above and below its own line
